prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] A close-up of <Subject 1> at night by the river, looking down at his phone as a faint, genuine smile appears.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and the collar of his dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and soft highlight roll-off, with deep blue night tones and warm golden bokeh.
[Shot 1] A close-up frames the face and shoulders of <Subject 1>, slightly from below and in three-quarter view, as he looks down at a phone held just below the bottom edge of the frame. His natural short black hair, his straight dark eyebrows and the collar of his dark blue-gray overshirt over the gray T-shirt are clearly visible. Cool white light from the phone screen softly lights his face from below, catching his cheekbones, the tip of his nose and his eyes, which reflect two small points of light. Behind him, warm city lights across the river form large, round golden bokeh circles against deep blue darkness, and a soft warm rim of light outlines the back of his hair and shoulder. His face starts calm and attentive as he reads. Then a faint, genuine smile slowly appears: the corners of his mouth lift a little and his eyes soften, and the smile stays. His eyes remain on the screen. His expression is warm and quietly confident, natural and restrained, with no laugh and no exaggerated reaction. His lips stay together. The camera holds a static shot for the whole duration, with his face in sharp focus. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Low riverside ambience and soft water movement continue, with a light breeze.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads with a soft low pulse and a low, sustained bass note, kept low in volume.
